name: Vitals
author: Blair Williams
description: A compact multi-machine system monitor in the OmaStats style: CPU, GPU, memory, disks, network, sensors and battery for this machine and any others you can reach over SSH, chosen per machine, in a narrow sidebar docked to a screen edge or in its own window. Click any readout for OmaStats' full detail panel for that machine. Agentless: nothing is installed on the remote machines, and nothing needs root. Works with Linux and macOS remotes.

barWidget.description: A pulse icon that shows or hides the Vitals sidebar: CPU, GPU, memory, disk, network, sensor and battery readouts for every machine you add, over SSH, configurable per machine.

schema.label: Display mode
schema.description: dock pins a sidebar to a screen edge and tiles windows beside it; window opens the same content as an ordinary window.

schema.label: Dock edge
schema.description: Which screen edge the docked sidebar sits on.

schema.label: Width
schema.description: Sidebar and window width, in pixels.

schema.label: Dock screen
schema.description: Output name for the docked sidebar, such as DP-1 or eDP-1 (see hyprctl monitors). Empty lets the compositor choose, usually the focused screen.

schema.label: Sample every (seconds)
schema.description: How often each machine reports. macOS machines round to whole seconds.

schema.label: History (seconds)
schema.description: How much history each machine keeps for its graphs.

schema.label: Keep sampling while hidden
schema.description: Keep the SSH sessions open while the sidebar is hidden, so graphs have history when it opens and the bar icon can flag offline machines.

schema.label: Bar readout
schema.description: icon shows just the pulse glyph; count adds online/total while sampling.

schema.label: Default readouts
schema.description: Comma-separated, in order: cpu, gpu, memory, disks, network, sensors, battery. Machines without their own readouts (set from a card's gear) show these.

schema.label: Default look
schema.description: How readouts draw unless a machine sets its own: graph, ring, text (figure), both (graph and figure), or ring-text (ring and figure).

schema.label: Labels
schema.description: Stacked letters (CPU, MEM, NET) like OmaStats, or icons.
